plugin.name: Wbcom CAPTCHA Manager
plugin.namespace: global (WBC_* / Recaptcha_For_BuddyPress* / BPRC_* class prefixes — no PSR-4 namespace)
plugin.text_domain_note: Text domain AND directory name must remain `buddypress-recaptcha` — the text domain derives from the WP.org slug and cannot be renamed to match the product name.
plugin.requires_at_least_rationale: Set by blocks/login-widget/block.json apiVersion 3, which requires WP 6.3+. This is the real, code-justified floor. History: 2026-06-04 deliberately set a truthful floor of 5.9 (the str_starts_with() ceiling at the time); a later commit overwrote it with 6.9 with no code justification; the block's apiVersion 3 makes 6.3 the honest value. Do not raise without a code reason.
plugin.description: Multi-provider CAPTCHA for WordPress (login/register/lost-password/comments), WooCommerce, BuddyPress, bbPress, and 7 form builders. 5 providers, 14 integrations, 29 protectable contexts.
plugin.distribution: wbcomdesigns.com (EDD SL SDK keyless auto-updates, item_name 'reCaptcha for BuddyPress')

endpoints.purpose: Issues an ALTCHA proof-of-work challenge. Public — required for the client-side widget to fetch a challenge before submission. Registered on rest_api_init at file scope; class-altcha-lib.php is required by includes/services/class-altcha-service.php:22, so this route is live whenever the ALTCHA service file loads.

ajax.purpose: AJAX login widget/block — accepts user/pass, verifies the active CAPTCHA service, calls wp_signon. Returns JSON with display_name + redirect_to (no email after 2.1.0).

admin_pages.title: WB Plugins
admin_pages.conditional: Only registered when empty( $GLOBALS['admin_page_hooks']['wbcomplugins'] ) — i.e. when this is the first Wbcom plugin to load. Peer plugins are auto-discovered via $GLOBALS['submenu']['wbcomplugins'].
admin_pages.note: BPRC_Admin::takeover_hub_landing runs on admin_menu priority 999 to reclaim the hub landing render when a legacy wbcom-wrapper plugin registered wbcomplugins first.

admin_pages.title: Wbcom CAPTCHA Manager
admin_pages.note: Card-panel admin. Tab slugs map 1:1 to legacy WBC_BuddyPress_Settings_Page sections — wbc_save()/wbc_output() switch on these strings, do not rename. The menu cap gate (manage_options) runs BEFORE render_page(), so the in-page nonce save is layered defense, not the sole gate.

settings.purpose: Per-context enable toggle (29 contexts). NOTE: the 'bp_register' context maps to wbc_recaptcha_enable_on_buddypress, not _signup_bp.
Active provider id (recaptcha-v2 / recaptcha-v3 / turnstile / hcaptcha / altcha)
Per-provider API credentials (with hyphen-form + legacy wc_settings_tab_recapcha_* fallback for backward compat)
Widget theme — the ONLY live theme option. Shared across reCAPTCHA v2 + hCaptcha. Turnstile and ALTCHA ignore it.
Widget size — the ONLY live size option. Shared across reCAPTCHA v2 + hCaptcha.
IP whitelist — exact IP, dash-range (1.2.3.4-1.2.3.10), or CIDR (10.0.0.0/24, IPv4 only) since 2.1.0. Falls back to the legacy typo key wbc_recapcha_ip_to_skip_captcha at manager:481.
Block forms when the active service is unconfigured or verify() throws (instead of fail-open). Filter: wbc_captcha_fail_closed.
Require per-context nonce on plugin-controlled forms. Filter: wbc_captcha_strict_nonce. Wired in reCAPTCHA v2 + hCaptcha + Turnstile verify(). NOT wired in reCAPTCHA v3 or ALTCHA.
Per-context disable-submit-until-verified toggle (works for reCAPTCHA v2; hCaptcha wired in 2.1.0)
Dequeue other plugins' reCAPTCHA scripts to prevent conflicts

blocks.name: wbc/login-widget
blocks.title: CAPTCHA Login
blocks.purpose: Gutenberg login block — renders the AJAX login form with the active CAPTCHA. Its apiVersion 3 is what sets the plugin's real WP 6.3 floor.
blocks.note: Block name is `wbc/login-widget` per block.json, NOT `buddypress-recaptcha/login`. The pre-2026-07 manifest recorded the wrong name.

widgets.purpose: Classic-widget counterpart to the login block; shares WBC_AJAX_Login_Handler.

capabilities.use: All admin pages + settings save handlers. Plugin defines NO custom capabilities.

integrations.definition: An integration is REAL only when it has BOTH (a) a public wiring class required in includes/class-recaptcha-for-buddypress.php and (b) an admin settings module registered in admin/includes/settings-modules/class-wbc-settings-module-loader.php:81-94. All 14 below satisfy both. Honest breakdown: 4 platform + 7 form builders + 3 e-commerce/membership = 14.
integrations.counting_rule: The count is 14 because there are exactly 14 settings modules. NOTE: WordPress core (login/register/lost-password) and WordPress comments are 15 wiring points but ONE integration — they share a single settings module (WBC_WordPress_Settings) and one Protection-tab section. Do not count them twice.

platform.name: WordPress core
platform.note: ONE integration covering 4 surfaces. Comments are registered unconditionally — NOT gated on WooCommerce; each callback self-checks its own enable flag. The comment field/verifier classes live in the woocommerce-extra/ directory for historical reasons only.

explicitly_not_integrated.note: DO NOT record these as integrations. All four were previously advertised in readme.txt with ZERO first-party code; the false claims were removed 2026-07-16. Verified absent by grep across all non-vendor PHP/JS.

items.name: Fluent Forms
items.evidence: No wiring class, no settings module, no context key, zero grep hits outside vendor/.

items.name: Formidable Forms
items.evidence: No wiring class, no settings module, no context key. The ONLY hits are inside the vendored ALTCHA library (includes/lib/altcha/settings.php:488-495, helpers.php:13-14, class-altcha-lib.php:63,205-206) — and that library's settings.php/admin.php are deliberately never required (fork note at class-altcha-lib.php:620-633), so even that code never runs.

items.name: WS Form
items.evidence: No wiring class, no settings module, no context key, zero grep hits outside vendor/.

items.name: FluentCart
items.evidence: No wiring class, no settings module, no context key, zero grep hits outside vendor/.

services.purpose: Registry + dispatcher for all 5 CAPTCHA services. Registers defaults at :63-84, fires wbc_register_captcha_services at :97, resolves the active service from the wbc_captcha_service option, owns IP-whitelist skip (:216, :473-481) and fail-closed policy (:283, :320).

Base class — owns context→nonce, context→form selector, context→submit selector, and context→enable-option maps (get_context_option_map at :159-191, 29 contexts). Provides no-conflict, IP-restriction, and render/verify guards (:442, :465).
Interface for custom 3rd-party services registered via the wbc_register_captcha_services action.

services.label: Google reCAPTCHA v3 (score-based)
services.note: Does NOT fire wbc_captcha_verified — it uses the v3-specific wbc_recaptcha_v3_verify filter instead. Strict-nonce is NOT wired for v3.

services.label: ALTCHA (self-hosted proof-of-work)
services.note: Requires includes/lib/altcha/class-altcha-lib.php (at class-altcha-service.php:22), which also registers the /altcha/v1/challenge REST route. Strict-nonce is NOT wired for ALTCHA.

services.label: hCaptcha
services.note: Reads the SHARED wbc_recaptcha_theme/wbc_recaptcha_size options (:126-127), not wbc_hcaptcha_theme/_size — see static_analysis.dead_options.

services.purpose: Card-panel admin. Registers the shared WB Plugins hub + CAPTCHA submenu (manage_options), renders 6 tabs via includes/admin/views/{shell,hub,overview,updates,discover}.php, and processes the settings save by delegating to WBC_BuddyPress_Settings_Page::wbc_save() — same nonce field/action/option keys as the legacy admin (UX-only migration).
Legacy WooCommerce-style settings engine. Still the save/render backend that BPRC_Admin delegates to; owns 11 of the 13 settings extension filters.
Loads (:81-94) and registers the 14 per-integration settings modules; fires wbc_recaptcha_register_settings_modules at :153.
Migrates old hyphen-format options to underscore format (e.g. wbc_recaptcha-v2_site_key → wbc_recaptcha_v2_site_key). Runs on admin_init priority 5 when is_migration_needed().
Maps legacy wc_settings_tab_recapcha_* keys onto the wbc_* namespace.
Runtime bridge for the recapcha→recaptcha typo family. NOTE: does NOT bridge the error-message keys to the wc_settings_tab_* names the readers use — see static_analysis.saved_but_not_applied.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_register_captcha_services
hooks_fired.purpose: PRIMARY EXTENSION POINT — allows 3rd-party plugins to register custom CAPTCHA service implementations (must implement WBC_Captcha_Service_Interface).

hooks_fired.name: wbc_recaptcha_register_settings_modules
hooks_fired.purpose: Allow extensions to register additional settings modules.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_recaptcha_settings_saved
hooks_fired.purpose: Fires after the settings page saves a section — extensions can react to settings updates.

hooks_fired.name: bp_accept_tos_errors
hooks_fired.purpose: BuddyPress signup ToS-acceptance hook fired during BP register CAPTCHA validation. Third-party (BP-ecosystem) hook name, intentionally not wbc_-prefixed.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_should_render_captcha
hooks_fired.purpose: Last-mile filter to skip captcha rendering for a specific context/request.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_should_verify_captcha
hooks_fired.purpose: Last-mile filter to skip captcha verification. Since 2.2.0 it is applied by WBC_Captcha_Service_Base::should_skip_verification() and honoured by ALL five providers; before that only reCAPTCHA v3 consulted it, so the filter (and the wbc_recaptcha_ip_to_skip_captcha allowlist) hid the widget without skipping the check on the other four.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_captcha_verified
hooks_fired.note: Fired by 4 of the 5 services. reCAPTCHA v3 does NOT fire it — v3 consumers must use wbc_recaptcha_v3_verify instead. The pre-2026-07 manifest wrongly claimed 5 firers.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_captcha_fail_closed
hooks_fired.purpose: Override the wbc_captcha_fail_closed option per-request — when true, missing config (:283) or a verify exception (:320) blocks instead of failing open.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_captcha_strict_nonce
hooks_fired.purpose: Override the wbc_captcha_strict_nonce option per-request — when true, the per-context nonce is required.
hooks_fired.note: Not wired in reCAPTCHA v3 or ALTCHA — strict-nonce has no effect when either is the active service.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_recaptcha_v3_verify
hooks_fired.purpose: v3-specific verification filter (operates on the score-bearing API result). This is v3's replacement for wbc_captcha_verified.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_recaptcha_v3_score_threshold_value
hooks_fired.purpose: Override the reCAPTCHA v3 score threshold per-context.

hooks_fired.name: anr_recaptcha_domain
hooks_fired.purpose: Override the Google reCAPTCHA hostname (e.g. google.com → recaptcha.net for users behind the GFW). Third-party-compatible hook name (advanced-nocaptcha-recaptcha), intentionally not wbc_-prefixed.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_recaptcha_*_settings (13 settings filters)
hooks_fired.purpose: Settings-page extension points for sub-tabs / fields. 11 fired by WBC_BuddyPress_Settings_Page, 2 by WBC_Settings_Module_Loader.

hooks_fired.name: altcha_* (8 vendored-library hooks)
hooks_fired.purpose: Vendored ALTCHA library hooks — internal to the ALTCHA service, NOT part of the plugin's public API.
hooks_fired.note: Only the hooks inside class-altcha-lib.php are reachable; those in settings.php/admin.php never fire because those files are never required.

hooks_fired.name: wbc_recaptcha_v3_is_captcha_page
hooks_fired.purpose: Pre-load the reCAPTCHA v3 api.js on a page the built-in allowlist cannot detect. render() self-enqueues, so this is only needed when a form is injected so late that it renders after the footer scripts have printed.

hooks_not_owned.note: Fired by this plugin but owned by WP/WooCommerce core — re-dispatch only, NOT extension points of this plugin. Excluded from the hooks_fired_unique count.

dead_code_files.evidence: Runtime-confirmed dead before deletion: class_exists('WBC_Setup_Wizard') === false and function_exists('altcha_enqueue_scripts') === false on a booted WP 7.0 + BP 14.5 install.
dead_code_files.impact: None. All deleted on 2026-07-17. includes/lib/altcha/class-altcha-lib.php is retained and unchanged apart from its fork note.
dead_code_files.action: Done. Do not re-add. render_widget() in class-altcha-lib.php references the dropped helpers.php and is unsupported in this fork - see the fork note.

dead_options.evidence: Never user-reachable: its only writer was wbc_appearance_settings(), which no tab ever routed to. No badge rendering code has ever existed in the plugin (no .grecaptcha-badge CSS, no data-badge attribute).
dead_options.impact: None - the control was never visible, so removing it changes nothing a user could see.
dead_options.action: OWNER/QA CALL before implementing. Needs the v3 token path moved from implicit grecaptcha.execute() to explicit grecaptcha.render({badge,size:'invisible'}), plus Google's mandatory attribution text when the badge is hidden/inline. New feature on a security-critical path; not verifiable without real Google keys. The wc_settings_tab_demo_recapcha_v3_badge -> wbc_recaptcha_v3_badge migration is retained so legacy values survive.

rest_hang_risks.note: AJAX login uses jQuery $.ajax without explicit timeout — failed networks leave the form spinner indefinitely. Low risk for a short login round-trip but worth a 30s timeout in a future refactor.

hook_signature_drift.note: Fires with 3 args (verified, result, context) at class-recaptcha-v3-service.php:313. The pre-2026-07 manifest documented 2 args — integrators written against that doc will miss $context.
Fires with 1 arg ($section) at class-wbc-buddypress-settings-page.php:2446. The pre-2026-07 manifest documented 0 args.

plugin_dev_rules.note: CARRIED OVER from the 2026-06-04 baseline — NOT re-run in the 2026-07-16 structural refresh (wppqa was explicitly out of scope). Treat these numbers as provisional until the next wppqa run. The 1 finding in the migrated card-panel is a false positive — the menu is registered with manage_options which WP enforces before render_page(), so the in-page nonce save is layered defense, not the sole authorization.

rest_js_contract.reason: the 1 ALTCHA REST route has no JS contract with plugin-owned JS

resolved_2026_07_17.appearance_options: FIXED. WBC_Captcha_Service_Base::get_appearance_option() resolves wbc_<provider>_<name> -> shared wbc_recaptcha_<name> -> default. hCaptcha + Turnstile now read their own keys; reCAPTCHA v2 resolves to the shared key exactly as before. Turnstile previously read per-context keys (wbc_turnstile_theme_<context>) that no screen ever wrote. The live Advanced tab now renders theme/size for whichever provider is active, defaulting to the currently-effective shared value so appearance does not change on upgrade.
resolved_2026_07_17.error_messages: FIXED. wbc_get_custom_captcha_error_option() in includes/captcha-verification-helper.php bridges wbc_recaptcha_error_msg_captcha_<type> -> wbc_recapcha_error_msg_captcha_<type> (typo spelling written by WBC_Settings_Migration) -> *_v3 keys when the v3 flow is active -> wc_settings_tab_recapcha_* . Advanced tab now exposes all three types; each field defaults to the currently-effective message so saving cannot clobber a legacy custom message.
resolved_2026_07_17.hcaptcha_error_fatal: FIXED (P1, previously unrecorded). wbc_get_captcha_error_message() guarded on method_exists(), true for protected methods, then called $service->get_error_message() from global scope. WBC_HCaptcha_Service::get_error_message() was protected -> PHP Error 'Call to protected method ... from global scope' on EVERY failed hCaptcha verification, across ~30 integration paths. Guard is now is_callable(); the method is public. CONTRACT: any service's get_error_message() must be public.
resolved_2026_07_17.test_connection: REMOVED. testCaptchaConnection() in admin/js/wbc-admin-dynamic.js never made an AJAX call and reported success whenever both fields were non-empty. Its only two triggers were the deleted setup wizard and wbc_service_documentation()/wbc_*_docs() in the settings page - which nothing ever called (quick setup uses wbc_simple_documentation() instead). Both the JS and the dead docs methods were deleted; no live button ever existed, so no endpoint was built.
resolved_2026_07_17.activation_redirect: FIXED. The class_exists('WooCommerce')||class_exists('BuddyPress')||class_exists('bbPress') gate was removed from recaptcha-for-buddypress.php.
resolved_2026_07_17.gruntfile: FIXED. cssmin/uglify/watch/rtlcss now target public/, admin/css, admin/js and assets/ (cssmin:admin, cssmin:chrome, uglify:admin, uglify:chrome). NOTE: the plugin enqueues UNMINIFIED sources everywhere, and nothing loads the min/ or rtl/ output - a separate open question, not a regression.
resolved_2026_07_17.unreachable_settings_screens: OPEN - needs an owner call. wbc_output()/wbc_save() only ever receive BPRC_Admin::get_tabs() slugs with form=>true (rfw-general/protection/advanced). wbc_appearance_settings() and wbc_advanced_settings() were deleted (sole writers of the never-read keys; superseded by the live Advanced tab). Still unreachable and LEFT ALONE because they carry an explicit 'Keep backward compatibility' marker: wbc_service_settings() (the default: case), wbc_wordpress_settings(), wbc_woocommerce_settings(), wbc_buddypress_settings(), wbc_bbpress_settings(). Note wbc_service_settings() still renders wbc_hcaptcha_theme/_size fields, which are now LIVE keys - harmless only because the screen is unreachable.

buddypress_integration.manager: WBC_Captcha_Service_Manager (per-context render via bp_register / bp_signup_validate hooks)
buddypress_integration.note: BuddyPress is now 1 of 14 integrations, not the plugin's centre of gravity. The slug, text domain, and directory name are historical (WP.org) — see plugin.text_domain_note.

nonce_pairs.purpose: Admin settings save. Preserved from the legacy admin so an in-flight save posted from either UI stays valid.

nonce_pairs.verified_at: verify() in reCAPTCHA v2 (:204), hCaptcha (:260), Turnstile (:164)
nonce_pairs.purpose: Per-context CSRF protection — advisory by default, mandatory under wbc_captcha_strict_nonce. NOT enforced by reCAPTCHA v3 or ALTCHA.

coding_rules: All option keys prefixed wbc_ (or legacy wbc_recapcha_ / wc_settings_tab_recapcha_ for original-typo back-compat). Before adding an option, grep BOTH the write and read side — this plugin has a documented history of write-only keys (see static_analysis.dead_options).

Settings UI is WooCommerce-style (uses woocommerce_admin_field_*, woocommerce_settings_* hooks even when WC is absent). The plugin makes ZERO live register_setting() calls — do not assume the Settings API.
Per-context behavior dispatched via context-string maps (nonce/selector/option), not OOP polymorphism — see WBC_Captcha_Service_Base::get_context_option_map().

An integration is only real when it has BOTH a public wiring class AND a settings module. Never advertise an integration in readme.txt without both — see integrations.explicitly_not_integrated for the four false claims removed on 2026-07-16.
EDD SL SDK is keyless (no license check) — plugin updates from the wbcomdesigns.com EDD store, item_id 1246648. Do not touch the SDK or its item_id.

ALTCHA is a vendored library at includes/lib/altcha/ — modifying its files is a deliberate fork (e.g. the 2.1.0 REMOTE_ADDR-only fix, and the deliberate non-loading of its settings.php/admin.php documented at class-altcha-lib.php:620-633).
Text domain and directory name stay `buddypress-recaptcha` regardless of the product name — the text domain derives from the WP.org slug.
